policy.purpose: external clean-address training/evaluation corpus; not bundled in the runtime package
policy.filter: Russian rows with 1-64 whitespace tokens, known tags, matching token/tag lengths, and at least one StreetName, StreetNumber, or Unit tag
policy.deduplication: first row for each BLAKE2b-128 hash of case-folded, ё/е-folded, whitespace-normalized address text
policy.grouping: SHA-256 of structured province/county/district/municipality/suburb/street/house identity; unit and presentation fields are excluded so one building cannot cross splits
policy.split: group hash buckets: train 90%, validation 5%, test 5%
policy.sample: lowest deterministic SHA-256 ranks from the sealed test split

limitations: The source is curated from open geographic address data and does not reproduce misspellings or punctuation-heavy user input.
Country and Suburb have no direct public package field and are kept as source context but mapped to O.
This deterministic test split becomes tuning data after its failures are used to change the parser; reserve another test source before making a final production claim.
